objective: Repair Boltz-2 ligand stereochemistry and geometry by direct, reasoning-driven edits to pretrained weights.
weight_scope: Regular checkpoint files in the project root; original external checkpoints are read-only.
primary_metrics: modern CIP chirality agreement under graph isomorphism
secondary_metrics: bond and angle RMS error against independent ETKDGv3/UFF conformer
protein CA RMSD and ligand displacement after paired protein alignment
selection: Inspect weights and development predictions, document a mechanistic hypothesis before every edit, and use validation only after development improvement. Freeze a selected candidate before test evaluation. A failed candidate is not a repaired model.
failure_policy: Retain failures and report denominators. Retry only identifiable execution errors with their original record preserved; do not silently exclude chemical failures.
limitations: Single prediction seed in the initial benchmark
Sequence threshold does not exclude all remote homology
Paired displacement is not experimental pose accuracy
Successful local edits may not generalize outside ct209
